'''''Alamania''''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that was commandeered by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator Sneakaway|senator]] escaping from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when it [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|fell]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
